label: alpha-ketoglutarate
citation: Ishak Gabra et al., Nat Commun 2020 (PMID 32620791); Pan et al., Nat Cell Biol 2016 (PMID 27749823)
note: Only panel member with direct in vivo melanoma glutamine-supplementation evidence. Km from TET2/KDM4 range 20-60 uM; intracellular pool 100-300 uM.

label: glutathione (reduced)
citation: Dixon et al., Cell 2012; Stockwell et al., Cell 2017
note: Pool is millimolar and homeostatically buffered (gamma-GCS feedback inhibition by GSH), so flux change couples weakly to concentration.

label: glutamate
pathway: Cystine/glutamate antiport (xCT), GSH precursor, GLS product
citation: Koppula et al., Protein Cell 2018; Sato et al., JBC 1999
note: Intracellular pool 2-20 mM, far above effector Km: kinetically saturated, so poorly responsive.

label: UDP-N-acetylglucosamine
citation: Li et al., Nat Commun 2018 (PD-L1 N-glycosylation); Yang & Qian, Nat Rev Mol Cell Biol 2017
note: Glutamine is the obligate amido donor at GFAT, the committed step; pool tracks flux closely.

label: aspartate
citation: Birsoy et al., Cell 2015; Sullivan et al., Cell 2015
note: Aspartate is rate-limiting for proliferation under respiration-impaired conditions.

label: asparagine
pathway: mTORC1 / ATF4 stress signalling; T cell activation
citation: Krall et al., Nat Commun 2016; Hope et al., Nat Commun 2021
note: Direction is compartment-dependent: tumour-promoting in cancer cells, required for CD8 T cell activation.

label: ammonia
pathway: Ammonia accumulation -> T cell exhaustion, autophagy induction
citation: Bell et al., Cell Metab 2023 (ammonia and T cell dysfunction); Eng et al., Mol Cell 2010 (ammonia-induced autophagy)
note: Stoichiometric by-product of both GLS and GLUD steps; acts mainly on the immune compartment, not tumour-intrinsically.

label: (S)-2-hydroxyglutarate
citation: Intlekofer et al., Cell Metab 2015; Losman & Kaelin, Genes Dev 2013
note: Opposes alpha-ketoglutarate at the same effectors; relevant under hypoxia/LDHA activity even without IDH mutation.

label: citrate
pathway: ACLY -> acetyl-CoA -> histone acetylation, de novo lipogenesis
citation: Wellen et al., Science 2009; Carrer et al., Cancer Discov 2019
note: Reductive carboxylation of alpha-ketoglutarate makes this a direct glutamine sink.

label: fumarate
citation: Sullivan et al., Mol Cell 2013; Xiao et al., Genes Dev 2012

label: succinate
pathway: HIF stabilisation; SUCNR1 signalling on myeloid cells
citation: Selak et al., Cancer Cell 2005; Rubic et al., Nat Immunol 2008

label: proline
citation: Phang, Antioxid Redox Signal 2019; Elia et al., Nature 2017
note: Glutamate-derived; supports matrix remodelling and metastasis.

label: putrescine
pathway: Polyamine synthesis -> eIF5A hypusination; myeloid immunosuppression
citation: Puleston et al., Cell Metab 2019; Holbert et al., Nat Rev Cancer 2022

label: spermidine
pathway: eIF5A hypusination, autophagy, T cell fitness
note: Direction is compartment-dependent (supports both tumour growth and T cell function).

label: ornithine
citation: Geiger et al., Cell 2016; Grzywa et al., Front Immunol 2020
note: Links glutamine carbon to arginine-depletion immunosuppression.
